samples.summary: Editable share view mounts SheetView without `onUndoJump`, so cross-tab undo stays invisible there — and the new prop doc claims that view is read-only, which is false for editor-role links
samples.evidence: packages/frontend/src/app/shared/shared-document.tsx:300 renders `<SheetView tabId={activeTabId} readOnly={readOnly} peerJumpTarget={peerJumpTarget} />` with no `onUndoJump`/`undoJumpTarget`. `readOnly` there is `resolved.role === "viewer"` (shared-document.tsx:198), so an editor-role share link renders an editable sheet, and that view has its own multi-tab switcher (shared-document.tsx:304-324). Undo is therefore enabled with multiple tabs and `Sheet.applyUndoSelection` finds `onUndoTabJump` unregistered, so a step replayed in another tab still 'looks like it did nothing' — the exact defect the change exists to fix. The new comment at packages/frontend/src/app/spreadsheet/sheet-view.tsx:165-166 states the omission is 'the read-only share view … moot there since undo is disabled', which does not hold for role !== viewer. Fix belongs either at shared-document.tsx:300 (wire the two props) or on the new comment.

samples.summary: `handleUndoJump` switches `activeTabId` to an id taken from `root.sheets` without the tab-existence/type check every other jump path in this file performs
samples.evidence: handleUndoJump (document-detail.tsx:158-162) calls `setActiveTabId(selection.tabId)` unconditionally. The peer-jump path in the same component validates first — `const activeTab = peerActiveTabId ? root.tabs[peerActiveTabId] : undefined; if (activeTab?.type === "sheet")` (document-detail.tsx:621-623) — and the comment jump only switches to an anchor tab it resolved from the doc. `selection.tabId` originates from `Object.keys(root.sheets)` in YorkieStore.snapshotTabs (packages/frontend/src/app/spreadsheet/yorkie-store.ts:1346), i.e. the `sheets` map, not `tabs`/`tabOrder`. A `sheets` entry with no matching `tabs` entry (legacy/migrated docs; `worksheet-shape-migration.ts` operates on `sheets` directly) makes `activeTab` undefined at document-detail.tsx:669, which falls through to the SheetView branch (line 756) with a tabId absent from `tabs`, and TabBar (line 774) then highlights no tab. Also lets a coordinate-less 'incidental' step yank the user to a pivot tab. I could not confirm an orphan `sheets` entry is reachable today — both deletion paths (document-detail.tsx:509 and packages/backend/src/yorkie/tab-ops.ts:104) clean `sheets` — hence medium confidence.

samples.summary: `snapshotTabs` enumerates the Yorkie `sheets` record with raw `Object.keys`, bypassing the repo-wide `safeWorksheetRecordKeys` invariant applied to that same record elsewhere
samples.evidence: packages/frontend/src/app/spreadsheet/yorkie-store.ts:1346 `for (const tabId of Object.keys(root.sheets))`. The repo has a dedicated wrapper for exactly this hazard — `safeWorksheetRecordKeys` recovers from the Yorkie proxy's duplicate-ownKeys TypeError (packages/sheets/src/model/workbook/worksheet-record.ts:33-45) — and it is applied to the `sheets` record specifically at packages/backend/src/api/v1/worksheet-lookup.util.ts:41 (`if (!sheets || !safeWorksheetRecordKeys(sheets).includes(tabId))`, with the rationale in its comment at line 30) and to `tabs` at packages/backend/src/api/v1/tabs.controller.ts:259. Elsewhere in this very file the safe variants are used (yorkie-store.ts:648, 760, 1076). If the proxy throws here, `snapshotTabs` runs inside `replayHistory` on both sides of the replay, so undo/redo rejects after the CRDT mutation has already been applied.

samples.summary: The design doc's `Store` interface snippet still advertises `undo(): Promise<boolean>`, contradicting the new `UndoResult` contract described later in the same (updated) file
samples.evidence: docs/design/sheets/sheet.md:352-353 lists `undo(): Promise<boolean>; redo(): Promise<boolean>;` in the `Store` interface block, while the same document, updated by this change, states at line 561-562 that "`Store.undo()` returns an `UndoSelection { tabId, otherTab, selectionType, range? }`". The actual signature is now `undo(): Promise<UndoResult>` (packages/sheets/src/store/store.ts:349). The snippet was already stale before this change, but the change edits this file and leaves the two halves disagreeing.
